name: Foundations of National Accounts Statistics (SNA 2008)
description: Comprehensive self-paced e-learning on System of National Accounts (SNA 2008) principles, GVA compilation at basic prices, and GDP aggregates for official statistical officers.
learningOutcomes: Understand SNA 2008 core accounting identities and sequence of accounts
Calculate GVA across primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors using enterprise financial returns
Distinguish between product taxes and production taxes in GDP valuation

modules.title: Macroeconomic Aggregates & Valuation Standards
learningOutcomes: Mastering GDP, GVA, NNI concepts
Factor cost vs basic prices

modules.title: Sectoral GVA Compilation & Production Accounts
learningOutcomes: Compiling manufacturing and service sector value added
Intermediate consumption deductions

modules.title: Supply and Use Framework Fundamentals
learningOutcomes: Input-output balance mechanisms
Trade and transport margins

name: Consumer Price Index (CPI) & Inflation Compilation Methodologies
description: Essential training on price statistics collection, Modified Laspeyres index formulation, item substitution, and rural/urban market quotation validation.

competencies.name: Index Numbers & Price Statistics (CPI, IIP, WPI)

learningOutcomes: Master the Modified Laspeyres index calculation formula
Validate monthly price quotations from selected rural and urban retail markets
Handle missing price observations through geometric mean and carry-forward imputation

modules.title: Basket Selection & Weighting Diagrams
learningOutcomes: CES weighting derivation
COICOP classification

modules.title: Price Scrutiny & Elementary Aggregates
learningOutcomes: Price relative calculation
Outlier detection in monthly quotes

modules.title: Sub-Group and All-India Index Aggregation
learningOutcomes: State-level indices
All-India general index synthesis

name: Sampling Theory and Survey Design in Official Statistics
description: Comprehensive course on multi-stage stratified survey design, PPSWR, circular systematic sampling, sampling multipliers, and estimation for NSS rounds.
learningOutcomes: Formulate multi-stage stratified designs for national socio-economic surveys
Calculate exact sampling multipliers and weights for rural and urban sample units
Compute design effects (deff) and standard errors for complex survey estimators

name: Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) Schedule Canvassing & Balance Sheet Analysis
description: Detailed operational guide on canvassing ASI schedules, auditing factory profit & loss accounts, validating capital structure, and resolving unit-level non-response.
learningOutcomes: Understand statutory requirements under the Collection of Statistics Act 2008 for ASI
Validate balance sheet fixed and working capital entries against audited company statements
Apply consistency cross-checks across energy consumption, wage blocks, and output accounts

name: Time Series Analysis & Seasonal Adjustment with X-13ARIMA-SEATS
description: Advanced training on stochastic time series decomposition, ARIMA modeling, calendar/trading day adjustments, and official seasonal adjustment pipelines.

competencies.name: Statistical Computing with R for Official Statistics

learningOutcomes: Diagnose ACF/PACF plots and test for time series stationarity
Execute X-13ARIMA-SEATS seasonal adjustment on monthly IIP and CPI series
Model holiday and trading day variations in Indian macroeconomic series

name: R for Official Statistics: Survey Data Wrangling & Weighted Analysis
description: Practical hands-on course covering R tidyverse verbs, survey design objects with the survey package, weighted microdata tabulations, and reproducible RMarkdown reports.

competencies.name: Statistical Computing with R for Official Statistics

learningOutcomes: Wrangle multi-gigabyte survey unit-level microdata using dplyr and data.table
Construct complex survey design objects in R with stratum and cluster specifications
Generate official weighted summary tables with Taylor linearization standard errors

name: Python for High-Throughput Statistical Data Engineering
description: Modern Python for statistical data engineering: high-speed dataframes with Polars/Pandas, automated ETL pipelines, data validation, and REST API integration.

competencies.name: Python for Data Engineering & Official Statistical Analytics

learningOutcomes: Build automated data cleaning and transformation pipelines using Python and Polars
Process large census and enterprise datasets with minimal memory footprint
Develop internal microservices for automated statistical verification

name: CAPI Survey Instrument Design & Mobile Field Deployment
description: Mastering Computer Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI): designing mobile survey schedules in CSPro/Blaise, programming validation logic, and managing field synchronization.

competencies.name: Computer Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) & Digital Capture

learningOutcomes: Author structured CAPI survey questionnaires with dynamic skip logic and rosters
Embed realtime consistency checks and range validations in field instruments
Manage offline data synchronization, GPS tagging, and paradata audit trails

name: SDMX 3.0 Standards & Global Statistical Metadata Exchange
description: In-depth guide to Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange (SDMX): Data Structure Definitions (DSD), codelists, concept schemes, and automated international dissemination.
learningOutcomes: Understand the SDMX 3.0 information model and architecture
Construct DSDs and codelists for national SDG indicators
Configure automated SDMX endpoints for UN and IMF data reporting

name: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) in Official Statistics
description: Operationalizing the IMF/UN/MoSPI Data Quality Assessment Framework across survey lifecycles, evaluating accuracy, timeliness, methodological soundness, and serviceability.

competencies.name: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) & Quality Assurance
Statistical Audit, Process Validation & System Documentation

learningOutcomes: Conduct systematic DQAF assessments on survey and administrative statistics
Quantify non-sampling errors, response attrition, and coverage deviations
Implement division-level Quality Assurance Guidelines

name: Official Statistics Ethics, UN-FPOS & Collection of Statistics Act
description: Essential legal and ethical foundations: 10 UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics, statutory powers and obligations under Collection of Statistics Act 2008, and respondent privacy.
learningOutcomes: Interpret statutory provisions and penalties under the Collection of Statistics Act 2008
Uphold the 10 UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics in daily governance
Protect respondent confidentiality and prevent unauthorized microdata leaks

name: Field Survey Team Leadership & High-Performance Enumeration Management
description: Leadership and operational management for survey supervisors: team motivation, field conflict resolution, route optimization, inspection spot-checks, and quality assurance.

competencies.name: Field Survey Team Management & High-Performance Supervision

learningOutcomes: Lead and motivate field enumeration squads across challenging survey environments
Execute rigorous supervisory spot checks and re-interviews
Optimize team tour programs to hit strict round completion deadlines

name: Statistical Data Storytelling, Visualization & Public Dissemination
description: Translating complex statistical metrics into clear visual narratives for policymakers, media, and citizens: dashboard design, press releases, and ethical data presentation.

competencies.name: Statistical Data Storytelling, Visualization & Public Dissemination
Open Government Data Dissemination & API Stewardship

learningOutcomes: Create clear, non-misleading visual charts and infographics from official data
Draft concise press release summaries and executive briefings
Communicate statistical uncertainty and confidence intervals effectively
